name: agentphoto
description: Skills to run AgentPhoto (the photo studio your AI agent can run): retouch photos (colour and light correction, looks, portrait retouch, crop and straighten), remove backgrounds and make masks with local AI, build social / marketing visuals from templates with text, shapes and layer effects, look at headless renders to check every change, and export PNG / JPEG / WebP in every size. Non-destructive JSON layer stack, nothing uploaded, no server, no account.
